purpose: Integrate the cosmology-owned coupled environmental-state result into Geometry Before Fields without waiting for BHSM bridge closure.
scientific_reframe: Do not say the temporal X2 state requires a one-dimensional isolated attractor.
Say specified environmental density/velocity data at the R1 anchor can span both temporal topographic components.
Keep temporal-state generation distinct from spatial profile/axis selection.
On isotropic R1, orientation can be transmitted from environmental n=2 coefficients but is not created from an isotropic state.
A one-profile observable model is a special spatial-rank condition, not the fundamental ontology.
manuscript_edits: Create a new section from the supplied LaTeX insertion draft, preferably after the action-native matter/backreaction section and before observable-specific kernels.

In the Introduction, replace any implication that the two-component temporal state itself must be selected by an isolated mode with the coupled-state formulation. Preserve the statement that spatial profile/axis remains conditional.
In the claim-status table, revise the selected-state row to distinguish TEMPORAL REALIZATION from SPATIAL PROFILE/AXIS selection.
In the conclusion, add one concise sentence that the coupled R1 environment can source both temporal components, while physical environmental initial data and spatial reduction remain open.
Do not add S0/S1 low-z proxy details to the main manuscript in this pass.
must_not_change: Existing luminosity-distance, transverse-BAO, growth, Weyl, optical kernels.
Submission-ready remote main until the integration branch has passed review.
validation: Reproduce the coupled environmental-state audit from current code.
Verify rank(U_XE)=2 at every reported post-anchor epoch.
Verify the matter-only (delta_m,v_m) determinant is nonzero at every reported epoch.
Verify no observational data are used to choose E_i.
Run focused cosmology tests and full repository pytest.
Build LaTeX with zero unresolved references/citations and no overfull boxes.
Require RETUNING=false in the integration receipt.

decision_rule.accept_if: The new section is fully supported by the frozen R1 six-state system and all validations pass.
decision_rule.reject_if: Any text implies the z=2.1 environmental state is derived from earlier history, that a unique axis is selected, or that the microscopic BHSM-to-R1 normalization is closed.
